title: HabWorlds stellar calculation reference
description: Permitted tool reference transcribed from the supplied spreadsheet. Arithmetic equivalence is tested; this is not a complete or grading-verified HabWorlds lesson.

operations.description: Distance from parallax in arcseconds; returns light-years.
Luminosity from received flux and distance. Convert light-years to metres, calculate watts, then divide by solar luminosity.
Temperature in kelvin from peak wavelength in nanometres.
Main-sequence stellar mass from luminosity in solar units. Not applicable to giants or white dwarfs.
Main-sequence stellar radius from solar luminosity and temperature in kelvin; follows the supplied worksheet's applicability restriction.
Main-sequence stellar lifetime from mass in solar units; returns years, not billions of years.

references.measurements: Flux describes received power per square metre. Parallax is supplied in arcseconds; wavelength is supplied in nanometres.
references.solar_units: Lsun, Msun, and Rsun denote luminosity, mass, and radius relative to the Sun. Preserve the spreadsheet's constants.
references.applicability: The inspected HabWorlds UI restricts stellar mass, radius, and lifetime reconstruction to main-sequence stars. Star class is provided in this pilot.
references.completion: Completing these stellar calculations does not complete a real HabWorlds star or submit the project.
